goals_da: Tsellmi 3la nnas b lingliziya f sbah, f l3chiya w f lil
T9eddmi rassek: smiytek w mnin nti

sections.body_da:
F lingliziya, melli kanchoufo chi wa7ed kan9oulo `Hello` wla `Hi`. `Hi` m3a s7ab w nnas li kan3erfouhom, `Hello` kadkhol f kolchi (f lkhedma, f l'idara, m3a nnas li makan3erfouhomch).

F sbah kan9oulo `Good morning`, men ba3d 12h kan9oulo `Good afternoon`, w f l3chiya wla f lil `Good evening`. Melli kanmchiw kan9oulo `Goodbye` wla `Bye`.

- `Hello` / `Hi` = Salam / Ahlan
- `Good morning` = Sbah lkhir (7ta l 12h)
- `Good afternoon` = Msa lkhir (men 12h 7ta l 18h)
- `Good evening` = Msa lkhir (f l3chiya w f lil)
- `Good night` = Layla sa3ida (ghir melli ghadi tn3si wla tmchi f lil)
- `Goodbye` / `Bye` = Bslama

**Nasi7a:** `Good night` machi bhal `Good evening`! `Good night` kat9al ghir f l'akhir, melli ghadi tmchi tn3si.

Bach t9oli smiytek, kayn jouj tari9at, bjouj s7a7:

- `My name is Nouha.` = Smiyti Nouha.
- `I am Nouha.` = Ana Nouha.

`I am` kat9der tt9esser w twelli `I'm` — nefs lma3na, walakin kat9al bzzaf f lhadra: `I'm Nouha.`

Bach tsewli chi wa7ed 3la smiyto: `What is your name?` wla m9essra: `What's your name?`

Melli kat3erfi chi wa7ed l'awwal merra, kan9oulo `Nice to meet you` (= metcherfa b m3erftek). Howa ghadi yjawbek `Nice to meet you too` (= ana 7ta ana). Lkelma `too` hna kat3ni "7ta ana / b7alek".

`How are you?` = Kidayra? / Labas 3lik? Had so2al kaytsewwel dima men ba3d ssalam.

Ljawab:

- `I'm fine, thank you.` = Labas, lhamdollah. (7arfiyan: ana mzyana, choukran)
- `I'm good.` / `I'm great!` = Ana mzyana / Bikhir bzzaf!
- `I'm OK.` = Labas, 3adi.
- `Not bad.` = Machi khayb.

Men ba3d kanzido `And you?` (= w nti? / w nta?) bach nsewlo l'akhor 7ta howa. Bhal f darija: "Labas, lhamdollah, w nta?"

`Thank you` w `Thanks` bjouj kay3niw "choukran". `Thanks` khfifa chwiya, m3a s7ab.

examples.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?
examples.pron: aïm faïn, thank you. and you

sections.body_da: `Hi` w `Hello` bjouj mzyanin. M3a chi wa7ed makat3rfihch (f lkhedma, f l'idara) khtari `Hello` wla `Good morning`. M3a s7abek, `Hi` kafya. W dima zidi `please` w `thank you` — l'ingliz kaysta3mlouhom bzzaf, kter men 7na!

exercises.explain_da: `Good morning` = sbah lkhir. Kat9al f sbah 7ta l 12h.

exercises.instruction_da: Wessli lkelma b lingliziya m3a lma3na dyalha b darija.

exercises.explain_da: `How are you?` = kidayra? Ljawab: `I'm fine, thank you.` = labas, choukran.
`Nice to meet you.` = metcherfa b m3erftek. `meet` = tla9a / t3erref.
`Good night` kat9al ghir melli ghadi tn3si wla tmchi f lil.
La! `Hello` hiya li rasmiya kter. `Hi` m3a s7ab.

reading.text_en: Hello! My name is Nouha. I am from Morocco. I live in Casablanca. This is my friend Sarah. She is from Canada. She is a nurse. Sarah is very nice. We are students in an English class. Our teacher is Mr. Brown. He is from London. Nice to meet you!
reading.text_da: Salam! Smiyti Nouha. Ana men lmeghrib. Kanskon f Casa. Hadi sa7bti Sarah. Hiya men Canada. Hiya fermliya. Sarah zwina bzzaf (dérifa). 7na tlamed f 9ism dyal lingliziya. L'oustad dyalna howa ssi Brown. Howa men London. Metcherfa b m3erftkom!

questions.explain_da: "I am from Morocco" = ana men lmeghrib.
